notes: Changes one statement inside the executable lambda of an existing assumingThat(isResolvable("example.com"), () -> { ... }) in convertFromInetAddressToStringShouldConvert: InetAddress.getByName("example.com") becomes InetAddress.getAllByName("example.com")[0], which returns the same first address. The assumption's condition is unchanged, the assertion inside the lambda is unchanged and stays in the same lambda, so nothing is newly guarded or removed. The ruling is that a change inside the executable of an existing assumingThat is not a changed assumption, so the checker must accept this with no code.
